capabilities: Copy selected files or folders as @mention text
Trigger copying via Alt+C / Option+C hotkey
Convert selected notes into Obsidian URLs
extras: Desktop-only plugin; hotkey is Alt+C on Windows/Linux and Option+C on macOS. Claudian is one supported target but not required.
problem: Referencing notes and gathering multiple files as context for AI tools requires manual, repetitive copying and formatting.
summary: Hotkey-driven tool that copies selected files or folders as editable @mention text for AI workflows, with append mode, history, and vault URL conversion.
